frozen_manifest_unit.title: Fuertes smFRET efficiency versus dye-distance inference
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Test that mean FRET efficiency and a model-derived dye-to-dye distance remain distinct.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Does the working measurement pattern keep Fuertes mean FRET efficiency separate from the model-derived dye-to-dye distance?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Fuertes et al. (2017), Decoupling of size and shape fluctuations in heteropolymeric sequences reconciles discrepancies in SAXS vs. FRET measurements, PNAS 114:E6342-E6351.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: distinct RG and dye-to-dye-distance quantities from SAXS and smFRET.

exact_pdf_locators.locator: PDF p. 2, PNAS E6343, Figure 1 caption and adjacent Introduction
exact_pdf_locators.scope: I(q) versus q and FRET-efficiency representations.

exact_pdf_locators.locator: PDF p. 3, PNAS E6344, Figure 2 caption and Eqs. 1-2

source_objects.native_observable: Single-molecule FRET efficiencies, including burst-wise measurements and a mean FRET efficiency.
source_objects.estimand: A dye-to-dye distance inferred from mean FRET efficiency through a stated distance-distribution and dye model.
source_objects.statistical_unit: Burst-wise observations from a doubly labeled protein under the reported measurement conditions.
source_objects.spatial_support: Donor-acceptor separation at specified labeled termini, not a global all-pairs structural average.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: The paper discusses smFRET temporal sensitivity while its distance mapping uses mean efficiency and a distribution.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: The efficiency-to-distance mapping uses a dye-pair Förster distance and an assumed distance distribution.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: Dye/linker geometry and distribution-model choice constrain the inferred distance.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The paper describes mean FRET efficiencies used to infer mean dye distances for terminally labeled proteins.
The source distinguishes the inferred dye distance from the actual unlabeled-protein end-to-end distance and states model assumptions.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: This is the smFRET member of an exposed source pair; it is not a conversion formula for a SAXS quantity.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The primary record is FRET efficiency; dye-to-dye distance is an inference conditional on stated mapping assumptions.
forbidden_generalizations: Treat inferred dye distance as the raw measurement.
Treat the dye distance as automatically identical to an unlabeled end-to-end distance.
missing_information: SI-level calibration parameters and all dye controls are not extracted.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Preserve raw efficiency, derived estimand, labeled spatial support, and mapping assumptions.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.

source_projection.unit_or_aggregation: burst-wise efficiencies summarized by a mean

irrelevant_obligations: No numeric modality conversion or F06 edge result is produced.

analyst_divergence_classification_before.claim_boundary: The analyst records a projection, not a RuleResult or scientific conclusion.

defects.rule_or_field_affected: F03R01_SOURCE_NATIVE_MEASUREMENT native observable, estimand, and measurement-semantics declaration
defects.evidence_gap: No evidence gap: the abstract distinguishes mean FRET efficiency and model-inferred dye-to-dye distance, consistent with the declared source fields.
defects.dependency_or_route_issue: No dependency or route issue: the source-local declaration has the required evidence and DIRECT_EVALUATION is appropriate.
defects.claim_ceiling_consequence: The measurement-semantics-only ceiling is supported; the PASS does not claim reliability, comparability, validation, or scientific support.

smallest_candidate_repair.description: No repair is needed; retain the frozen rule, binding, direct route, and claim ceiling.

critic_review.summary: The permitted Fuertes locators support keeping mean FRET efficiency as the native observable distinct from the model-derived dye-to-dye distance. The SOURCE scope, required evidence, direct evaluation route, PASS condition, and measurement-semantics-only claim ceiling are aligned with the dossier.
